description: This file defines an HTTP parser module with classes and functions for parsing HTTP requests, headers, and handling chunked encoding, including utilities for request processing and header management.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods to access headers, URL, method, and parameters.

classes.name: HttpParser
classes.description: Provides methods to parse HTTP request data, handle chunked encoding, and process request headers and body.

methods.name: consumePostPadded
methods.description: Main method to process HTTP POST data, handling chunked encoding and content length, invoking request and data handlers.
